interface.longDescription: Package an idea from your conversation into one self-contained HTML document. Choose Sage, Paper, or Midnight; use Markdown, tables, and embedded images; organise longer ideas into pages within the same file. Includes a bundled renderer and concise instructions. File creation requires a session with file tools; Node or Bun enables automatic rendering, with an HTML template fallback. No hosting service or external account is required to read exported ideas.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Idea Zone to turn this conversation into a polished, shareable HTML document.

name: idea-zone
description: Turn complex conversations into polished, portable single-file HTML documents with Markdown, embedded images, tables, and page navigation.
